title: Missing Cents
description: split_bill(total_cents, people) splits a bill into shares (in cents) that add up exactly to the total. When it doesn't divide evenly, the first people pay one cent more.
hint: Add up the shares for a 100-cent bill split three ways.
explanation: Floor division throws away the remainder: 3 × 33 = 99, so a cent goes missing. `divmod` returns both the share and the remainder, and the remainder is spread one cent at a time over the first few people.
